description: This file contains client-side API helper functions for interacting with the backend of a food delivery application. It provides methods to list restaurants, get restaurant details, manage menus and menu items, create and manage orders and carts, handle payments, and retrieve tracking events. These functions serve as an abstraction layer over the API endpoints, facilitating communication between the frontend and backend services.

methods.name: listRestaurantsApi({ q = null, city = null, limit = 20, offset = 0 } = {}, getToken)
methods.description: Lists restaurants with optional search query, city filter, limit, and offset.

methods.name: getRestaurantApi(restaurantId, getToken)
methods.description: Fetches details of a single restaurant by ID.

methods.name: listMenusByRestaurantApi(restaurantId, { include_inactive = false } = {}, getToken)
methods.description: Lists menus for a specific restaurant, with an option to include inactive menus.

methods.name: listMenuItemsApi( restaurantId, menuId, { include_unavailable = false } = {}, getToken )
methods.description: Lists items for a specific menu within a restaurant, with an option to include unavailable items.

methods.name: createCartApi(restaurantId, getToken)
methods.description: Creates a new cart (order in CREATED status) for a specified restaurant.

methods.name: getOrderApi(orderId, getToken)
methods.description: Retrieves an order or cart by its ID.

methods.name: upsertCartItemApi(orderId, { menu_item_id, quantity }, getToken)
methods.description: Adds or updates a line item in the cart based on menu item ID and quantity.

methods.name: removeCartItemApi(orderId, { menu_item_id }, getToken)
methods.description: Removes a line item from the cart.

methods.name: createPaymentIntentApi({ order_id, amount_cents }, getToken)
methods.description: Creates a payment intent with order ID and amount.

methods.name: confirmPaymentApi({ order_id, client_secret }, getToken)
methods.description: Confirms a payment using order ID and client secret.

methods.name: placeOrderApi(orderId, { idempotency_key = null } = {}, getToken)
methods.description: Submits the final order to be processed.

methods.name: listMyOrdersApi({ status_filter = null } = {}, getToken)
methods.description: Lists the current user's orders with optional status filtering.

methods.name: listTrackingEventsApi(orderId, { limit = 50 } = {}, getToken)
methods.description: Retrieves tracking events for a specific order.
